Ollama v0.34.0
items.summary: Use Ollama models in ChatGPT Desktop Ollama models can now be used directly in ChatGPT Desktop, so you can keep your existing workflow while running open models. Setup is available from the Ollama app on MacOS. This release also improves structured output performance on Apple Silicon, adds support for OpenAI-compatible client tool search and response compaction, and makes images work correctly through compacted responses. Full Changelog : v0.33.3...v0.34.0-rc5
